etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English clyf, from Old English clif, from Proto-West Germanic *klib, from Proto-Germanic *klibą.

definitions.definition: A vertical (or nearly vertical) rock face.
(figurative) A point beyond which something abruptly fails or decreases in value, performance, etc.
